description: No answer before the deadline denies.

input.scenario: dev.example.a has no grant for dev.example.mail.send; the engine asks to send mail and the host asks the person over ACP session/request_permission with a 30 s deadline. The person never answers.

expect.behaviour: The call does not run; permission_denied after 30 s; record outcome timeout, decider {kind: policy, id: HCS-0005-R014}.
